A Bug's Life Storyboard Short: Tuck & Roll Change a Lightbulb (Full Episode)
Following life in the circus, "A Bug's Life's" Tuck & Roll try to maintain their new office jobs! How many bugs does it take? Hopefully not more than two... Directed by "Inside Out 2" Head of Story, John Hoffman, and Produced by Jesús Martinez!
